purpose: Dated medical/health news for Turkish clinicians and students. Not burs, egitim, duyuru, or research.
hard_rules: Fail-closed on undated news except documented official list exceptions.
Discovery aggregators are not canonical verification sources (Bible §6.2 / §24).
Engagement cannot justify clickbait or overclaim (Bible §14.3).
critical_relevance items are not auto-dropped for low engagement (Bible §23.3).
